what: A decorative shape laid around a section is scroll-linked from when the section’s top edge reaches 90% of the screen until the section’s bottom edge passes one more screen above the viewport, pulled up from 0 → to px (default −300) so it moves faster than the scroll. It fades in once over .3s ease-out when the decoration’s top edge reaches 90% of the screen — a company About decoration where round shapes float up around the text and drift by

options.to: Distance dragged at the end (px), default −300 — positive goes down. Original decorations range from −100 to −900, band decoration 30
options.start: Drag start (section-based ScrollTrigger start), default top 90%
options.scope: Ancestor selector for measuring drag, default nearest section (parent if none)

note: GSAP uses transform, so tilt is set with the rotate property. Position is set by the consuming CSS with position:absolute

from.where: shared.js .kh-parallax__item — peanut, pill, diamond and four-leaf shapes per section, pill band
